newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST AUSTRALIA.

text.p: Natal captain Dale Benkenstein won the toss and chose to bat first against Australia on the opening day of their four-day cricket match at Kingsmead on Thursday.
Natal - Doug Watson, Mark Bruyns, Errol Stewart, Jonty Rhodes, Dale Benkenstein (captain), Derek Crookes, Neil Johnson, Pat Symcox, Keith Forde, Gary Gilder, Tertius Bosch.
Australia - Matthew Hayden, Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Mark Waugh, Michael Bevan, Steve Waugh, Ian Healy, Paul Reiffel, Shane Warne, Glenn McGrath, Jason Gillespie.
